---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea, syntax improvement, or contribute a new feature to Thava.
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Motivation / Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. *I'm often frustrated when...*)

## Proposed Solution & New Syntax
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how the syntax should look.

## Example Thava Code
Show how developers would write code using this new feature:

```thava
# Proposed Thava syntax example:
func example() {
    // Show proposed syntax here
}
```

## Affected Components
Which component of Thava does this feature target?
- [ ] Direct Native Backend (x86-64 PE/ELF machine code emitter)
- [ ] ARM64 Backend (ARM64 machine code emitter)
- [ ] C++17 Transpiler (`--cpp`)
- [ ] Built-in Modules / Standard Library (`cons`, `os`, `time`, `clib`, `math`)
- [ ] CLI & Developer Tooling (`thavac`, `ThavaCompilerGUI`)
- [ ] Documentation & Examples

## Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Contribution
Are you interested in submitting a Pull Request to implement this feature?
- [ ] Yes, I would love to work on this!
- [ ] No, I'm just proposing the idea for the community.
